verdict.rationale: Beamer documents a 'changelog as a service' app and lets you restyle its embedded widget (color scheme, fonts). Nothing in the pack shows a standalone public changelog page or hosting it on a custom domain. Widget theming is a related but different feature and earns no credit toward a branded public page on a custom domain.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can serve a fully branded public changelog page on a custom domain
